evidence.quoted_text:
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: The tag-less path only checks that `target` is 40 lowercase hex characters. An annotated tag object ID meets that regex, and Git peels tag objects for `merge-base --is-ancestor`, `ls-tree`, and `show`, so all deployability checks can pass even though the object is not a commit. Because no `git cat-file -t` check requires `commit`, the documented `full commit SHA` precondition is not enforced and the recorded target can be a tag object rather than the commit checked out at HEAD.
